Ask: audit the repo for unused functions using parallel subagents - wanted: a list of unused functions. For you: three read-only audit agents are still running (lib/cli/unused, math/sort, parser_a/parser_b). I haven't got their results yet. Now: waiting on the three agents. Next: merge their findings into one report.

My own grep of the crate already shows this. `dead_code_helper_alpha` and `dead_code_helper_beta` in `src/unused.rs` are never referenced anywhere. `actively_used_helper` has no caller in this crate either, despite its name. It is `pub`, so it is part of the library API. The other `pub` items also have no in-crate callers: `add`, `quicksort`, `run`, and the parser functions. I'll classify those once the agents report.
